```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(arrow)
```

```{r}
open_dataset("data/daily_prices.parquet")
```

```{r}
open_dataset("data/daily_prices.parquet") |>
  slice_sample(n = 10) |>
  collect()
```

```{r}
open_dataset("data/daily_prices.parquet") |>
  filter(date_raw >= "2025-01-01") |>
  group_by(coin_id) |>
  summarise(avg_market_cap_usd = mean(market_cap_usd, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  arrange(desc(avg_market_cap_usd)) |>
  collect()
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
prices <- read_parquet("data/daily_prices.parquet")
metadata <- read_parquet("data/coin_metadata.parquet")
categories <- read_parquet("data/categories.parquet")

crypto <- prices |>
  mutate(date = as.Date(date_raw)) |>
  left_join(metadata, by = "coin_id") |>
  left_join(
    categories |> select(category_id, category_name),
    by = "category_id"
  )

crypto
```

```{r}
metadata |>
  select(coin_id, coin_name, launch_date)
```

```{r}
metadata <- metadata |>
  mutate(launch_date_parsed = coalesce(mdy(launch_date), ymd(launch_date)))

stopifnot(!anyNA(metadata$launch_date_parsed))

metadata |>
  arrange(launch_date_parsed) |>
  select(coin_id, coin_name, original = launch_date, parsed_date = launch_date_parsed)
```

```{r}
prices |>
  filter(coin_id == "btc") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = as.Date(date_raw), y = price_usd)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(
    title = "Bitcoin Daily Price",
    x = "Date",
    y = "Price (USD)"
  )
```

```{r}
crypto |>
  group_by(date, category_name) |>
  summarize(
    cat_market_cap = sum(market_cap_usd, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(category_name = fct_reorder(category_name, cat_market_cap, .fun = mean)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = date, y = cat_market_cap, fill = category_name)) +
  geom_area(position = "fill") +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = as.Date(c("2022-05-07", "2022-05-12", "2022-11-08", "2022-11-11")),
    color = "grey20",
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 0.4
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = as.Date(c("2022-05-09", "2022-11-09")),
    y = 1.02,
    label = c("Luna/UST crash", "FTX collapse"),
    angle = 90,
    hjust = 0,
    size = 3
  ) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "C") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent, name = "Share of Total Market Cap") +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1), clip = "off") +
  labs(
    title = "Crypto Market Cap Share by Category",
    subtitle = "Daily market-cap share of each category; dashed lines mark the May 2022 Luna/UST and November 2022 FTX events.",
    x = "Date",
    fill = "Category",
    caption = "Source: data/daily_prices.parquet; category labels from data/categories.parquet."
  ) +
  theme(plot.margin = margin(t = 24, r = 8, b = 8, l = 8))
```
